Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires and the players have made their way out in the middle. Murshida Khatun and Shamima Sultana are the openers for Bangladesh Women. It will be Lea Tahuhu to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Bangladesh Women were quite toothless with the ball. The moment they had the opportunity to put a lid over the run rate when Fahima Khatun went BANG, BANG! But well, that was not the case for them as they hardly put the batters in a precarious position. At the end, Bangladesh Women batters now have their task cut out. They need to bat out of their skins here if they wish to end their campaign on a positive now. Do join us shortly for the second essay.

New Zealand Women were off to a flier with their opening stand of 77 runs before Bernadine Bezuidenhout slipped out. Suzie Bates continued to spend time with the crease and settled the ship with Amelia Kerr. In no time, the pressure was back on New Zealand Women as they lost two wickets in two deliveries. Later, it was Suzie Bates who stuck around till the very end and smacked 81 runs. Maddy Green's quickfire innings off 20-ball 44 runs could well be the difference between the two sides at the end of the match.

The death bowling has certainly put down Bangladesh Women here. It is New Zealand Women who are the happier side at the end of the first innings. The runs were coming in thick and fast in the death which has helped them to post a mammoth total. New Zealand Women will certainly back themselves to get over the line here.
On a length and on off, Suzie Bates misses her stroke. The keeper fumbles to grab it as the batters cross for a bye. New Zealand Women end their innings for 189/3.
Two Wides! Bowls it down leg, Maddy Green misses her flick. The keeper misses it as well as the batters collect one.
A slower one, on off, Maddy Green scoops it towards fine leg for a brace.
Fuller and on off, Maddy Green looks to play at it but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls towards fine leg for a brace.
Bowls it fuller and on off, Maddy Green pulls it towards mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! This one lands on off, Maddy Green moves forward and drives it through extra covers as the ball races away from the fence like a rocket.
Fuller and on off, Suzie Bates drives it to cover for one.
Lands it on off, Suzie Bates punches it to covers for one.
Another one outside off, Suzie Bates looks to play at it but gets rapped on her pads. Dot.
Lands it outside off, Suzie Bates misses her stroke. A chance missed for stumping!
FOUR! Errs her line and bowls it on leg, Suzie Bates flicks it over backward square leg for a boundary!
Another one on middle, Maddy Green works it to mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it on middle, Maddy Green slogs it towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Fuller and on off, Suzie Bates reverse sweeps it through point for a boundary. Suzie Bates is on fire!

SIX! Oh, that was sloppy. Fuller and on off, Suzie Bates heaves it over mid-wicket. The ball carries towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket who shells it as the ball goes over the ropes for a maximum!
Lands it on off, Maddy Green flicks it to square leg for one.
FOUR! Fine shot. Fuller and on off, Maddy Green moves forward and lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, Suzie Bates plays it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, Maddy Green reverse sweeps it to backward point for one.
Bowls it fuller and on off, Maddy Green drives it to long off for one.
Lands it on off, Suzie Bates guides it to covers for one.
Fuller and on off, Maddy Green drills it to long on for one.
FOUR! Excellent timing. Fuller and on off, Maddy Green gets on her knee and reverse sweeps it through backward point for a boundary!
Bowls it on off, Suzie Bates flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Lands it outside off, Suzie Bates looks to reverse sweep it but misses.
Fuller and on off, Maddy Green drives it but finds the woman at covers.
FOUR MORE! Maddy Green has made up her ind now. Fuller and on off, Maddy Green hangs back and lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
FOUR! Sloppy fielding! A low full toss, on off, Maddy Green drills it through long on for a boundary. That was an easy stop for the fielder.
On a length and outside off, Maddy Green looks to slap it but misses.
FOUR! Fine shot. Lands it fuller and on off, Maddy Green strides forward and heaves it through cow corner for a boundary!
A low full toss, on off, Suzie Bates flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Maddy Green joins the party now. It is tossed up, full and on off. Green dances down the track, gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over the bowler's head for a fine boundary.
On the pads. Bates stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Goes full and on middle. Bates uses her feet and flicks it through the gap at mid-wicket for two runs.
FOUR! Powerfully hit! Back of a length, around off. Suzie Bates stands tall and pulls it down towards the cow corner and gets a boundary.
It is full and outside off. Suzie Bates reverse sweeps it down to third man. The batters take two runs.
Suzie Bates stays back to this short ball and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
This is full, angled into the pads. Bates flicks it past mid-wicket and takes a single. Also, FIFTY comes up for Suzie Bates.
Maddy Green stays back to the flat delivery and taps it to point for an easy single.
Goes full and on off. Green smacks it down the ground. The batters take two runs with ease.
A single now as this is clipped past mid-wicket.
Short and around middle. Bates pulls it down to long on and collects a brace.
Slower through the air, outside off. Suzie Bates helps it back to the bowler.
Maddy Green walks in.

OUT! TIMBER! Peach of a delivery. This one lands on off and turns it a shade, Sophie Devine moves forward to loft it but gets beaten. It deflects from her thigh and hits the stumps. Sophie Devine walks back for a golden duck and Fahima Khatun is on a hat-trick now!
Sophie Devine walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Bowls alow full toss, pace off, Amelia Kerr shimmies down the wicket to loft it but mistimes it completely. It carries back towards Fahima Khatun who pouches it well with both hands to her right. Amelia Kerr walks back into the hut!
Flatter and on off. Kerr stays back and hits it uppishly over extra covers. The batters come back for two runs with ease/
Short and on leg. Bates stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. She only gets a single this time.
Full and on off. Kerr drives it through covers for a single.

FOUR! Amelia Kerr gets up 100 for his side in some style. She is looking in good touch here.It is tossed up, full and on off. Kerr charges down the wicket, gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over mid off. It races away to the fence.
A single to end the over! Amelia Kerr dances down the track to this full one and lofts it over the bowler's head. They take a single.
Full and on leg. Suzie Bates drills it down to long on for one more.
Amelia Kerr stands back to this flat one and punches it towards point for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Bates reverse-sweeps it past backward point. The batters run three before the fielder cuts it out.
It is full and on off. Suzie Bates plays a lofted drive. It goes over covers. They collect a brace.
Floated and full, on leg. Kerr nudges it to mid-wicket. They take a single.
A bit short, outside off. Kerr stays back and cuts it through point. One taken.
Darted on the pads. Kerr hangs back and flicks it towards mid-wicket for two runs.
Flat and on off. Kerr stays back to tap it to point.
A single now as this is played down to long on.
Floated, on leg. Amelia Kerr flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Suzie Bates uses her feet and smacks this full ball down the ground to long on for a single.

Drinks! New Zealand Women, after electing to bat first, are 84/1 at the end of 10 overs. They look in good control of the game and will be aiming for a high total. Bangladesh Women will look to bag some quick wickets in the game and break this stand. Fahima Khatun comes into the attack now.
Flighted up, on off, Suzie Bates drills it to long on for one.
Fuller and on off, Amelia Kerr drives it to covers for one.
Lands it on middle, Suzie Bates pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it outside off, Suzie Bates uses the pace of the ball and guides it to third man for a brace.
Tosses it up on off, Suzie Bates slaps it to the woman at covers.
Bowls it on off, this is guided towards the fielder at short third man.
Slightly shorter, outside off, Suzie Bates slaps it to covers for one.
Lands it on off, Amelia Kerr taps it to covers for one.
Amelia Kerr is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! This one lands outside off, it turns away further, Bernadine Bezuidenhout moves forward to loft it but misses completely. Shamima Sultana behind the sticks grabs it and whips off the bails. Bernadine Bezuidenhout walks back after a fine knock!
Commentary.Howout: st Shamima Sultana b Shorna Akter

Commentary.Commentary: Lands it on off, Suzie Bates drills it to long on for one.
FOUR! Bowls it on off, Suzie Bates rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for four more!
No ball and NO BALL AND FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Suzie Bates pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. No ball as well for overstepping. Free hit coming up...
Tossed up, on off, Suzie Bates eases it to the woman at short covers.
Bowls it on middle, Bernadine Bezuidenhout works it towards deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Beautifully timed! Slightly shorter and outside off, Bernadine Bezuidenhout hangs back and cuts it through point for a boundary!
Lands it on off, Suzie Bates slaps it to covers for one.
Fuller and on off, Suzie Bates guides it to the fielder at short covers.
Bowls it on off, Suzie Bates eases it to the woman at point.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and slower too. Suzie Bates hangs back and drills it through long off as the ball races away from the fence like a rocket.
Ritu Moni comes into the attack.
Slightly shorter and on off, Bernadine Bezuidenhout flicks it to deep square leg for a brace.
Slight halt! Fahima Khatun looks in some pain here and is down on the ground. The physio is out in the middle with the magic spray. She looks fine now and we are good to go.
Fuller and on off, Suzie Bates drills it down the ground. Fahima Khatun puts her right leg to stop it as the ball rolls towards mid on. They collect one.
Lands it on off, Suzie Bates blocks it back.
Fuller and on off, Suzie Bates works it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Tossed up, on middle, Bernadine Bezuidenhout works it to mid-wicket for one.
A full toss, on off, Suzie Bates puls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fahima Khatun comes into the attack.
Quicker one, on off, Suzie Bates flicks it to mid on for one more.
Bowls it on middle, Bernadine Bezuidenhout flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Shorter and on middle, Bernadine Bezuidenhout picks it well and pulls it through square leg for a boundary!
Lands it on off, Bernadine Bezuidenhout gets on her knee and pulls it but finds the woman at square leg.
FOUR! More runs! Fuller and just outside off, Bernadine Bezuidenhout uses the pace of the ball and guides it through third man for a boundary.
Slower one, on off, Suzie Bates clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Goes full, on leg. Bernadine Bezuidenhout lofts it over mid on. The ball though lands safely. They take two more.
EDGY! It is tossed up, around off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout tries to push it through the line but only gets a thick outside edge. The batters take two runs before the fielder cuts it out.
Flighted, on leg. Bates closes the face and tucks it to the leg side for another single.
Floated and full, on the pads. Bernadine Bezuidenhout flicks it to mid-wicket and crosses.
Suzie Bates stays back to this short ball and punches it to extra cover. There is a misfield which allows the batters to cross.
Full and on off. Bates plays it late to short third.
A bit short, on off. Bates hangs back and punches it to mid off. They take a single.
FOUR! A good quality shot. A bit flatter, on middle. Suzie Bates stays back and smacks it through mid-wicket for a fine boundary.
Goes full and on off. Bates smacks it back to the bowler. Marufa Akter is able to make a half-stop here.
Fuller, on leg stump. Bernadine Bezuidenhout clips it to square leg for a single.
Suzie Bates hangs back to this short one and taps it out to mid off with soft hands. One taken.
A half-tracker, outside off. Bates miscues her shot towards mid off.
A single to end the over! It is flatter and on off. Bates goes for the flick but does not time it well. It goes high up but fortunately lands safely near cow corner.
Full and on off, knocked down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Back of a length, wide of off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout hangs back, waits for it and then guides it past backward point for a cracking boundary.
Bernadine Bezuidenhout once again gets the broom out and takes a couple of runs as there is protection in the deep.
Goes full and on off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout gets down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg. Two taken.
Full and on leg. Bates tucks it through mid-wicket for one run.
Around off, defended out watchfully.
On the pads, Bates stays back and nudges it to mid-wicket for one.
A single now as this is pushed to the off side.
Bernadine Bezuidenhout get low to this full ball and sweeps it towards square leg. No run taken.
Fuller, outside off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout sneaks it through the gap past backward point for two more runs.
Nahida Akter starts with a short one, outside off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout goes back and cuts it through point for a brace.
Nahida Akter to share the attack from the other end.
Suzie Bates hangs back to this full ball and blocks it back to the bowler.
Another single now! It is full and around off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout pushe sit to mid off and takes off.
A length ball, wide of off. Suzie Bates taps it out and crosses. She gets off the mark with a single.
Bernadine Bezuidenhout now taps this full ball to mid off and rotates the strike.
This is full, tailing into the pads. Bernadine Bezuidenhout flicks it towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! Bernadine Bezuidenhout and New Zealand Women are off the mark with a boundary. It is a length ball, outside off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout opens the face of te bat and steers it down to third man for four runs.

The match is set to begin. But first, the players line up for their respective national anthem. It will be Bangladesh first, followed by the national anthem of New Zealand. The players and umpires are now heading toward the center of the field. Suzie Bates and Bernadine Bezuidenhout are the openers for New Zealand Women. Marufa Akter to start he proceedings with the ball. Here we go...

Bangladesh Women (Unchanged playing XI) - Shamima Sultana (WK), Murshida Khatun, Sobhana Mostary, Nigar Sultana (C), Shorna Akter, Rumana Ahmed, Ritu Moni, Nahida Akter, Fahima Khatun, Salma Khatun, Marufa Akter.

New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Suzie Bates, Bernadine Bezuidenhout (WK), Georgia Plimmer, Amelia Kerr, Sophie Devine (C), Maddy Green, Hannah Rowe (In for Hayley Jensen), Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr, Eden Carson, Molly Penfold (In for Fran Jonas).
TOSS - New Zealand Women win the toss and opt to BAT first.

On the other hand, Bangladesh Women have also failed to make a mark in the tournament. They have lost both of their games as well. The two underdogs in the tournament will fight it out and their result would not have an effect on the top-two spots in the points table as they both are truly out of the race? Which side will come out on top? Let's find out together. Toss and team news to follow shortly...

Hello and a warm welcome to the 12th match of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2023 as New Zealand Women takes on the Bangladesh Women at the Newlands, Cape Town. The White Ferns are well on their way out of their tournament after a few disappointing results in the tournament. They have lost both of their games by a huge margin and are in a search of momentum. The team will hope to win this game and get back to winning ways.
... MATCH DAY ...

The group stage of the 2023 ICC Women's T20 World Cup is in full flow and in match number 12, New Zealand Women take on Bangladesh Women in a Group A clash and it is a must-win game for both sides. Both these teams came into the tournament as teams that can really hurt the opposition on a given day, especially the White Ferns but both teams have played a couple of matches each and haven't won a single game thus far. New Zealand Women are having a shocking campaign so far as they received a drubbing in both their matches, first against rivals Australia Women and then by the hosts, South Africa Women. They batted second in both those matches and lost the games by a huge margin and were surprisingly bowled out for just 67 against the hosts. A batting lineup that features the likes of Suzie Bates, Sophie Devine and Amelia Kerr hasn't got going at all but Bates has certainly been the most disappointing of the three. They need a confidence-boosting win here and need to win by a very big margin to even consider having and outside chance of qualification to the next stage of the competition. On the other hand, Bangladesh Women have done decently well with the bat in their games but it has been the bowling lineup that has failed to take wickets. In their opening game against Sri Lanka Women, they posted a defendable total but just didn't show enough skill with the ball in hand. In their next game against the reigning champions, their skipper Nigar Sultana made a superb half-century but didn't receive much support from elsewhere. On current form, Bangladesh Women will feel they have a good chance of pouring more misery onto the White Ferns and will be looking for their first win of the competition. New Zealand Women might be on the brink here but they do have the players that can blow the opposition out of the water but it remains to be seen if their mindset can stay positive enough or not. Right then, a crucial game but only one team can get their first win of the tournament. Who are you backing?
